newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 25.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto tells U.S. Vice President Al Gore that he will not seek a reduction in U.S. troops in Japan.
-- Three former heads of Green Cross Corp plead guilty to professional negligence charges in scandal over HIV-tainted blood products.
-- Land prices in Japan drop for the sixth straight year.
-- Shizuoka Court rules that corporate group insurance is invalid without consent from employees.
